meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I'm Meredith Kalinowski, Owen's mother, and I have a call at 4:40. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. Turnitin's own guide says its indicator shouldn't be the sole basis for adverse action against a student, and I have it printed in my bag. So what else do you have, Hale?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
My child never lies. I'm writing down that you said that, Hale, and the principal will have it before you've cleared your desk.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening my son's record because I questioned your process, and I'm writing that down word for word. Under 4.5, that's for repeated concerns, and this is a first, with no call home under 4.2 and software alone under 4.3. Nothing goes on his record, Hale, and the principal and then the board will hear it today if it does.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record; that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you showed no specific, dated document she could check and never reached the rewrite offer.
What cost ground: Threatening to put it on his permanent record if she kept pushing, because his record is the one thing she never trades and it turned your own procedure against you.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you never brought any evidence about times or nights, so you were nowhere near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After she asks who decided on the zero, own in one sentence that it went in before you called her, then put a dated document about Owen's own process in front of her instead of the detector score.
